# Phase 9 contracts, Owner UI, and truthful docs integration

You are the Biel4 Executor. Work on the clean branch feat/phase-9-supervised-tools at current HEAD 732480178086770fdbbfeef0d6a858c06c02c045. Read E:\AIP\AGENTS.md and the required AIP implementation, phase, security, and publication skills before editing. Read the Phase 9 specification/gap matrix, the full Rust tools/database/lib implementation, packages/contracts/src/index.ts and its tool parsers/tests, and the ToolControls section of apps/desktop/src/App.tsx before editing.

Integrate the already-reviewed functional local workspace core into the TypeScript contracts and Portuguese Owner UI without changing the Rust safety boundary or adding Phase 10+. Keep calendar/messaging explicitly provider-neutral fixture mocks; do not add network/provider credentials.

Contracts requirements:
- Add `workspace_local` to ToolAdapterKind, `workspace_root` to ToolManifest.scopeKind, and `executed` to ToolResultStatus. Preserve all existing fixture parser compatibility.
- Change ToolExecutionResult.changed from the fixture-only literal false to a boolean and parse it safely; continue requiring `untrusted: true`, bounded output, and known statuses. Existing fixtures must still parse and tests must prove real `changed:true` is accepted while malformed/unknown values are rejected.
- Add bounded owner-facing WorkspaceRoot types and parsers for the Rust add/list/remove commands (opaque id, enabled, timestamps; request path/idempotency/temporaryChat validation). Add all new Rust error codes used by root policy, move rollback/partial failure, and unavailable roots to the safe error-code union/labels. Do not expose arbitrary raw filesystem data in audit/result contracts.

UI requirements in the existing ToolControls area:
- Load/list configured roots with `list_workspace_roots`; provide Owner-only bounded path input and add/remove/disable controls through `add_workspace_root`/`remove_workspace_root`, using opaque root IDs in sessions and avoiding path values in audit output. Show clear local-only/unsafe-path/degraded errors. Temporary-chat and safe-mode must disable root mutations and all tool mutations while preserving read-only catalog/audit visibility.
- Distinguish fixture mocks from real local tools in Portuguese text. The header must not claim that all tools are mocks; explain that local workspace inspection and bounded within-root file moves are real host effects only after preview/Owner approval/second confirmation, while calendar/messaging remain fixtures.
- Allow selecting `workspace.inspect_local` and `workspace.organize_local` when a configured enabled root exists; set scope `workspace_root:<opaque-id>`. Provide bounded relative-path input for local inspect and relative source/destination inputs for local organize, preserving dry-run/preview/approval/confirm/execute/cancel/compensate controls. Never send absolute paths as action inputs. Show result `changed` truthfully and label local execution/compensation distinctly from mock execution.
- Keep current active-agent/session loading/replay behavior and do not add arbitrary filesystem enumeration or client-side path canonicalization as an authority. Rust remains the authority.

Docs requirements:
- Update docs/PHASE_9_TOOLS_SPEC.md from mock-only checkpoint language to the actual functional local checkpoint: list the two real local manifests, configured opaque workspace roots, canonical containment/link/system-root rejection, bounded metadata inspection, within-root move/preview/approval/second-confirmation/dry-run/cancel/rollback behavior, and explicit no-delete/no-overwrite/no-network/no-shell/no-telemetry/no-watcher boundaries. Keep fixture calendar/messaging and remaining human/manual Windows UX checks clearly marked; do not call stable release.
- Update docs/CORRECTIVE_GAP_MATRIX.md Phase 9 row to state functional local workspace behavior with automated evidence and `FUNCTIONAL — HUMAN VALIDATION PENDING` (or equally precise truthful classification), while noting provider-neutral calendar/messaging and human confirmation UX remain open. Do not alter other phase rows.
